instruction: Crisp studio photograph, full shot from a high angle. In a minimalist white studio with a seamless background, the woman in the white hooded outfit (R2) on the left has her back to the camera, lunging forward in a dynamic dance pose. The woman in the black hooded outfit (R1) on the right faces left, extending her right arm towards R2 as if initiating contact. Both dancers are barefoot on the clean white floor. Bright high-key studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft, distinct shadows on the ground.
elements: R1 extends her right arm toward R2 as the apparent initiator of contact
R2 lunges forward with her back to the camera while R1 faces toward her
R1 is the approaching/reaching dancer and R2 is the dancer being approached
Both R1 and R2 are barefoot during the dance interaction
The interaction takes place in a minimalist white studio with a seamless background

questions.q: Is R1 extending her right arm toward R2 as if initiating contact, rather than R2 extending her arm toward R1?
questions.element: R1 initiates contact by reaching toward R2

questions.q: Is R2 the dancer lunging forward with her back to the camera, rather than R1 being the one in that back-facing lunge?
questions.element: R2 holds the lunging back-facing role

questions.q: Does R1 face toward R2 while reaching toward her, rather than R2 facing toward R1 while reaching?
questions.element: R1 faces and reaches toward R2

questions.q: Is R1 the dancer taking the approaching contact-initiation role while R2 is the dancer being approached in the lunge?
questions.element: R1 approaches/reaches and R2 receives the approach
